title: CoinRun 52.80M dynamics xlarge capacity extension
question: At the complete CR-DYN-0011 offline-latent recipe, does increasing only dynamics capacity from 3,931,136 to 52,801,152 parameters improve held-out rollout quality and stability?
reason: CR-DYN-0011 uses only about 4.4 GiB of the available 23 GiB A10 memory during steady-state training. The user requested one approximately 50M dynamics model after nano-dreamer reproduces the completed best compatible chain. Existing scale evidence stops at 12.90M and was trained for only 20k updates under the rejected short-record protocol.
hypothesis: A 52.80M dynamics transformer trained for the same 200k updates on the same audited offline latents will model longer-range CoinRun evolution more accurately than the 3.93M medium baseline, improving shortcut and full-diffusion rollouts without weakening action conditioning.
falsification: Reject the capacity hypothesis if the run cannot fit the unchanged batch-16 protocol on one A10, if any terminal evaluator is missing, if mean-frame or horizon-16 shortcut PSNR improves by less than 0.5 dB over CR-DYN-0011, if action controls miss the preregistered absolute thresholds, or if direct visual review does not show greater temporal stability.

constants.tokenizer: CR-TOK-0003 n16.6m EMA checkpoint at 20,000 updates

data.reuse_policy: Read-only reuse of byte-identical CR-DYN-0011 raw and latent datasets after nano-dreamer validation succeeds.

compute.estimated_budget: One batch-16 compile/one-update fit preflight, followed by exactly 200,000 updates and the unchanged terminal evaluation suite if the preflight fits.
compute.shutdown_policy: Use only the existing A10 after CR-DYN-0011 and nano validation release it. Set a bounded shutdown timer for the measured ETA; stop after all terminal evidence is synchronized.

launch_gate.oom_policy: Record failed preflight and do not silently change batch, accumulation, architecture or precision.

success_criteria.rule: The exact 52,801,152-parameter model must compile and complete one optimizer update at batch 16 on the existing A10 before the formal from-scratch run starts.
The formal run must complete exactly 200,000 optimizer updates from scratch and produce checkpoint 199999 plus shortcut, full-256-step-diffusion and action-conditioning terminal evaluations.
Shortcut mean-frame PSNR and horizon-16 PSNR must each exceed CR-DYN-0011 by at least 0.5 dB on byte-identical held-out futures.
Aligned actions must beat batch-shuffled actions by at least 0.25 dB and all-noop actions by at least 0.5 dB at horizon 16.
Direct visual review remains mandatory; metric success alone cannot establish a usable or temporally stable world model.
